description: This PHP source file defines the SourceFactory class, which is responsible for loading and instantiating connector source classes based on a given class name. It includes method to dynamically include files, check for security issues (like directory traversal), and initialize the loaded source object.

classes.name: SourceFactory
classes.description: A factory class for loading connector source classes dynamically based on a class name string, with methods to include necessary files and instantiate classes.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Loads and returns an instance of a source class based on the provided class name, performing validation and optional initialization.
